primary_claim: Sparse autoencoders trained on single-cell foundation models (Geneformer, scGPT) recover over 107,000 interpretable features organized into causal circuits that recapitulate known molecular biology, converge across independently-trained architectures, and can causally steer computed cell differentiation state.

effect.metric: SAE features mapping to known biological concepts

contradicts_or_qualifies: Standard practice of evaluating biological foundation models by benchmark performance alone underestimates what the models contain
The field's habit of labeling these models 'virtual cells' as an established fact rather than an empirically tested claim
The authors' own earlier annotation-biased feature sampling (Paper 2) missed the hub features the model relies on most
limitations_stated: A significant part of the identified knowledge is correlational, not causal
The previous generation of models does not learn regulatory networks
Interpretability pipelines that pre-filter for biological annotation are structurally incapable of finding the unlabeled hub features the model relies on most
quote: The result was a pair of feature atlases: 82,525 features for Geneformer, 24,527 for scGPT, totaling over 107,000 features across 30 layers.
